scope: The former Army Museum street building at 7 Jana Kilińskiego in Białystok in its August 2020 museum configuration. Includes the three-storey exterior, projecting balconies, square-facing museum lettering and the rear. The adjacent building at number 7/1, museum exhibits and later site are outside scope.

originalReview.notes: August 2020 street view shows the beige and taupe three-storey mass, square-facing sign and medallion, narrow parapet, glazed street level, paired balconies and vertical white-and-red banners.
July 2020 reverse view shows the rear upper window and balcony rhythm, monopitch roof vents and corner sign. Ground level is partially hidden by a passing bus.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla was checked first. Two exact Rakoon CC0 originals published within a week of one another cover the two principal elevations and square-facing gable. The information board, event and unrelated square images are outside the reference selection.
